title: Interfaces for normalized continuous coefficients and stratified embedded lattices
statement: The normalized coefficient, section-action encoding, scalar comparison, restriction, coefficient extension, lattice and stratification structures used in [lem-zl-continuous-constructible-stratified-lattices], with the exact unchanged fields and definitions formerly declared in its Lean module. Coefficients pins integral quotient projections and rational values; Encoding pins identity maps and inverse-image units; ScalarComparison pins tensor units; Lattice retains an actual monic internal inclusion whose adjoint is an isomorphism; Stratified retains a finite refinement, reductions and all further lattice restrictions. Family packages the independent ordinary, coefficient, geometric and stratified components. These interfaces use [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations], [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], [def-constructible-stratification], [def-sf-proetale-locally-finite-free-module], [def-sfb-continuous-coefficient-module-equivalence-universe], [def-per-adic-base-stages], [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], [def-weil-pbc-continuous-scalar-map-universes], [def-weil-pbc-completed-continuous-module-encoding-universes].
